name: Autumn Rage
body:
Autumn Rage (Su)
Source Ultimate Wilderness pg. 36
The barbarian becomes a servant of the harvest. While raging, she gains a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks to reposition or trip. She also gains this bonus on attack rolls to confirm critical hits. A barbarian can have only one season-themed rage power, choosing between spring, summer, autumn, or winter rage.
